Title: 2025-02-03 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: === Heroes: Chromie ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Chromie ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] The tooltip for Chromie's Unravelling now mentions the increased cast range.

=== Heroes: D.Va ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing D.Va's Self-Destruct to instantly go off if the Mech was hit by Malthael's Death Shroud with Throwing Shade selected.

=== Heroes: Nazeebo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the healing from Nazeebo's Hexed Crawlers to show incorrectly in the Death Recap.

=== Heroes: Zul'jin ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Wrong Place Wrong Time to not grant stacks of You Want Axe.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Zul'jin's Guillotine to not instantly update its damage when casting Amani Rage.
